title: Log Inspector
summary: Write a Python log parser that emits JSON.
description: Use Python to read JSON Lines, loop over records, count selected event types, and write a machine-readable JSON report. The expected output is checked by the backend.

offline_hints.title: Think about the concept
offline_hints.content: Treat each line as a separate JSON record and decide what data your loop needs to count.

offline_hints.title: Investigate this area
offline_hints.content: Open `events.jsonl`, use `json.loads` for each line, and increment counters for `AUTH_FAIL` and `FILE_READ`.

offline_hints.title: Guided route
offline_hints.content: Write `/workspace/report.json` with `{"auth_failures": 3, "file_reads": 2}`. Keep it valid JSON; test by running `python3 -m json.tool report.json`.

completion_explanation: You completed Log Inspector. Review the evidence, compare the observed result with the expected state, and explain why it matters in a real defensive workflow.

network_requirements.description: No network interface is required for this mission.
